lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (Today's third customer... Judging by the outfit, is a courier?)

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Is this the café run by Demon Slayer?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Yes, it is. And you are...?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'm a courier sent from headquarters. One regular Americano, please.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Certainly... But it's probably best not to mention Demon Slayer in front of other customers. Headquarters should've informed you about that policy.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Sorry. I'll be more careful.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (I'd bet he asked the exact same question at two or three other cafés before finding ours.)

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: So... did headquarters send us something?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Your boss requested funding and supplies from headquarters for both the café and Demon Slayer operations. I'll move everything into your storage room.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (So that's why the boss went to headquarters—to apply for funding and supplies. That was surprisingly fast.)

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Wow... this is really bitter. I've only ever had sweet coffee before.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Then next time you should try one of the other drinks on the menu. I'd be happy to recommend something.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Thanks. Another shipment is arriving tomorrow, so I'll be back. By the way... is kopi luwak really made from cat poop?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Uh... not exactly. More accurately, the coffee beans come from civet droppings after they've passed through the animal's digestive system, but the coffee isn't made directly from poop. Besides, we don't even serve kopi luwak here. Though the coffee at that café across the street—"Whatever"—smells as awful as cat poop.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Their desserts are really good, though.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: True. But they don't care about making proper coffee at all. Honestly, I hope they go out of business sooner rather than later.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'd better get going. I still have more deliveries to make. See you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: We'll be looking forward to your next visit.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I heard you can make Mocha Latte here?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Not unlocked yet, huh... Well, get everything ready and I'll come back next time.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'll be heading off then. Don't forget to prepare the ingredients for Mocha Latte!

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I hope to finally try it next time I visit.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Did you manage to get that Mocha Latte I asked about last time?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Excellent! Finally! Here, this is your reward!

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Did you manage to get that Mocha Latte I asked about last time?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Still not ready, huh... Well, keep working on it. I'll check back next time.
